limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 为能审代码的开发者执行仓库阅读、可逆修改和验证，根组件是独立编码工具而非DSH插件。见[Q01](#research-q01)。
普通ACP/controller到Go Agent多轮采样、Gate/工具执行、按callID结果回会话再采样；显式shell输入走独立路径，不能混同授权。见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。

固定根组件2465个tracked文件材料不等全审。实际定向核README/Go依赖、DSH配置及文档，ACP/controller核心入口、Agent.Run/采样/工具结果/预算、Gate与subject nil分流、显式shell、取消和恢复预览/提交。外部DSH只核固定委派prompt与权限caller，保存原件/版本依赖；未全审全部前端、扩展/所有工具、OS沙箱/进程树/网络、完整checkpoint事务和凭据日志生命周期，不执行目标。
studio源码2.x开发线、MIT；npm1.x维护线、DSH配置包0.1.0/provider0.2.1-rc.2另计，均非同一发布版本；正式Host固定依赖源码provider0.2.1-rc.3，仅定向接线比较，未发行/安装验收。
模型/重试/命令及审批、配置、恢复成本未知；轮数/三轴预算不等所有费用硬封顶，根工具人工小样外部隔离增加负担。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。
能验代码的开发者仅在独立OS副本、无敏感资料和可观察模型额度下人工普通任务试用；先不启DSH自动委派，超资源阈值/来源或停止后状态不明即停并回退原办法。见[Q05](#research-q05)。
源码证明自主执行、部分权限/预算/恢复与缺项终态；合格率、净人工、全入口授权和同版自动委派未验。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。
干净采样才执行、结果配对、主体授权、readiness和恢复预览/提交再验值得复用；输入来源必须跨显式shell与普通模型两入口保真，不能仅复制Gate。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
真实编码工具闭环、干净采样提交、权限/结果证据与条件性恢复接线；多前端和ACP方便整合，未证明新模型算法或净节时。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
普通权限卡不覆盖ACP显式shell输入，远端文本不能因标User就当人类授权；非正轮数不设cap、费用检查有条件，rewind不撤shell/外部动作。所核Host源码与bundle pin亦不同，非默认部署漏洞实证。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。
未验证方向是自动委派与人类命令分开授权的ACP入口适配；对照现reject/前置分流/禁bash/OS隔离，测误授权、误拦及人工，简单上游修正足够即否定独立插件。见[Q06](#research-q06)。
根工具发行线、Go源构建/模型/账户与外部OS隔离；DSH另需精确同版provider、command/home及来源策略。完整表见[Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)成熟编码Agent+多前端整合novelty小幅9、非新范式18；[Q02](#research-q02)干净采样/结果回流与readiness有实质mechanism15，未到新核心方法23；[Q03](#research-q03)主体规则/恢复版本重查可条件迁移10，来源快捷路限制不是普适15；[Q04](#research-q04)多入口简化小幅8但版本/权限仍重，未到11。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)聊天建议转真实编码任务有实质workflow18，净工时未到26；[Q02](#research-q02)文件/命令及readiness缺项交付实质15但非已验产物23；[Q04](#research-q04)终端/Studio/ACP多入口实质reach10，跨版本/自动来源条件不支持15；[Q05](#research-q05)总费和组织经济增量未识别0，不拿未知成本当节省4。

recommendation.reason: 能验代码的开发者，可在独立OS副本、无敏感资料和可观察额度下人工直接用普通模型入口试代码阅读及一次可逆修改，DSH自动委派暂保持关闭。它比纯聊天多真实工具闭环、权限与未验证缺项证据，但显式shell输入另路、版本和预算/恢复均有条件，不能把reject当全输入只读隔离。达到人工时间或用量阈值、来源不明、结果错误或停止后状态未知时，应停扩大权限和重复执行，人工核文件与进程并从独立副本回退现工具。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)开发者仓库阅读/可逆修改/真实验证任务和验收结果明确，超泛需求15；未测反复需求强度与采用场景，未到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)真实工具循环、干净提交/readiness超只聊天6；[Q03](#research-q03)快捷shell来源和[Q05](#research-q05)现编码Agent同条件净收益未验，未到19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)实际Execute→callID结果→下一provider.Stream，[Q03](#research-q03)审批/显式shell活动caller及恢复分支，定向宿主保原件超片段6；未运行、跨版本组合非兼容验收，不到19。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)发行/home/同版与来源边界、[Q05](#research-q05)外部OS隔离/额度监测/副作用恢复负担重，金额工时未知；人工直用副本可退故非0，自动委派先关、无净收益依据，未到10。

data.reports:
# Reasonix > 独立开源编码 Agent，提供终端、Studio、浏览器和 ACP 入口，读取代码、修改文件并执行命令与测试。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix) - **版本号**：2.x Studio 开发线（README 声明；DSH 配置包 0.1.0 另计）（[固定提交 8a1fda41a7fd62654fc8113391f620c57c3ad51d](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/tree/8a1fda41a7fd62654fc8113391f620c57c3ad51d)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-29（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码沿核心工具闭环、ACP权限/输入与恢复补核；非全产品审计且未运行。根工具只限外部隔离、普通模型入口的人工小样；DSH自动委派先保持关闭，不能以reject保证所有输入只读。未来入口适配仍是假设。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：为能审代码的开发者执行仓库阅读、可逆修改和验证，根组件是独立编码工具而非DSH插件。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：真实编码工具闭环、干净采样提交、权限/结果证据与条件性恢复接线；多前端和ACP方便整合，未证明新模型算法或净节时。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **思考**：普通权限卡不覆盖ACP显式shell输入，远端文本不能因标User就当人类授权；非正轮数不设cap、费用检查有条件，rewind不撤shell/外部动作。所核Host源码与bundle pin亦不同，非默认部署漏洞实证。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 - **建议**：未验证方向是自动委派与人类命令分开授权的ACP入口适配；对照现reject/前置分流/禁bash/OS隔离，测误授权、误拦及人工，简单上游修正足够即否定独立插件。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 采用建议：能验代码的开发者仅在独立OS副本、无敏感资料和可观察模型额度下人工普通任务试用；先不启DSH自动委派，超资源阈值/来源或停止后状态不明即停并回退原办法。见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 核心贡献 真实编码工具闭环、干净采样提交、权限/结果证据与条件性恢复接线；多前端和ACP方便整合，未证明新模型算法或净节时。见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 关键质疑 普通权限卡不覆盖ACP显式shell输入，远端文本不能因标User就当人类授权；非正轮数不设cap、费用检查有条件，rewind不撤shell/外部动作。所核Host源码与bundle pin亦不同，非默认部署漏洞实证。见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 未验证方向是自动委派与人类命令分开授权的ACP入口适配；对照现reject/前置分流/禁bash/OS隔离，测误授权、误拦及人工，简单上游修正足够即否定独立插件。见[Q06](#research-q06)。 后续授权后一次性OS副本比现Agent/手工与Reasonix人工任务的diff、真实验证、费用、错误和恢复时间；自动ACP在同版组合先核普通文本/显式命令来源与硬隔离，失败/未知先停，不靠模型提示。 ## 场景与替代办法 为能审代码的开发者执行仓库阅读、可逆修改和验证，根组件是独立编码工具而非DSH插件。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 参照聊天建议加手工、现有编码Agent及人工直接Reasonix；多前端/ACP是接线增量，模型/OS能力继承，同条件收益未测。见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 依赖与流程 根工具发行线、Go源构建/模型/账户与外部OS隔离；DSH另需精确同版provider、command/home及来源策略。完整表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 先选正确发行/账户和隔离副本，人工普通任务只读→单写验成果→取消/恢复核真实状态；自动ACP另验来源与版本。步骤见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 成本与效果 模型/重试/命令及审批、配置、恢复成本未知；轮数/三轴预算不等所有费用硬封顶，根工具人工小样外部隔离增加负担。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 源码证明自主执行、部分权限/预算/恢复与缺项终态；合格率、净人工、全入口授权和同版自动委派未验。表见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：根编码Agent与DSH接入的真实工具闭环、输入来源授权、预算/恢复和可控采用条件是什么？ ### Q01 · 根项目与DSH集成各是什么，贡献在哪里？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 Reasonix 根项目是独立开源编码 Agent 工具，带终端、Studio 桌面、浏览器和 ACP（编辑器/宿主调用助手的协议）入口；本项研究根组件，不把它登记成 DSH 插件。它为能审代码、能验收变更的开发者读取仓库、修改文件、运行命令/测试。相比“聊天给修改建议再手工操作”，增量是实际模型—工具循环及权限、会话与恢复机制；相比已有编码 Agent，其多前端/ACP 接入主要是集成能力，尚无同条件正确率、净人工或费用对照，不能从功能数量推优势。 版本口径必须分开：固定 README 的版本表将当前 studio 分支列作 2.x Active development，npm 的 reasonix 则是 main-v2 的 1.x 维护稳定线。integrations/dsh-plugin/package.json 的 0.1.0 是配置包版本，既不是整个 Reasonix 的版本，也不证明固定提交已有同名可用发行二进制。README 明确模型是用户配置的服务，会收到程序读取的内容；本地程序不等于代码绝不出机。 DSH 配置包只插入 subagent-acp provider（command reasonix、args acp、permission reject）及名为 reasonix 的 tool-subagent，maxDepth=provider-managed。这是复用宿主 ACP 工具的接线，不是新协议或根项目全部能力的原创归因。docs/DSH.md 的真实 DeepSeek 验证绑定 0.2.1-rc.2，是作者报告，本轮未复现。当前 ACP 的 sessionPrompt 实际调用 session controller，Agent.Run 驱动 runToolLoop，并非仅返回计划；详细工具回流与失败提交见 Q02。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:64-74](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/8a1fda41a7fd62654fc8113391f620c57c3ad51d/README.md#L64-L74) 本机程序与远端模型、编辑恢复明确范围。
查看原文（11行） ```text ## What it is Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it reads code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step. You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry, and you pay the model provider directly. ## What you get - **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your project folder. - **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once you approve. - **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did. ```

        "question": "谁值得付出全周期成本，如何试用和退出？",
        "answer": "根工具存在可控而有价值的人工直接试用路径：能验代码的开发者，在一次性OS用户或等效外部隔离、无敏感资料的仓库副本里，用普通自然语言做代码定位/评审，先只读，再逐次人工批准一次可逆修改及真实验证。不把外部Agent生成的“!”输入当已获人授权的命令，不把默认reject、项目cwd或rewind当全局防护。DSH自动委派先保持关闭，待输入来源信任边界、实际同版兼容与子进程权限独立核清；这与根工具的人工试用是不同采用范围。\n\n试用前读回发行线、模型endpoint/home和计费身份、权限模式、有效正有限maxSteps或明确可观察的TaskBudget，另设可承受的人工时间、provider用量/现金和后台进程停止线。正轮数允许总结宽限轮与采样重试，Cost受价格完整性限制且轮后检查，不当厂商总账硬限；账户或使用量不可观察就不开始需要持续资源的任务。临时低额度凭据或本地模型也仍要核工具外发/本地资源，不将“无敏感资料”误解为不必管账户。\n\n#### 全周期成本\n\n| 阶段 | 现金与资源 | 人工与时间 | 已知条件与未知 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 首次 | 发行/模型服务或本地硬件、隔离环境成本未知 | 选1.x/2.x线、账户/home、OS权限及副本 | 未测安装兼容和配置工时；不拿Go源码可读当安装成功 |\n| 持续 | 多轮/重试/总结tokens、命令与测试资源未知 | 审批、diff/结果验证、预算读回与费用监测 | 有预算/收据机制，不证明净节时或精确费用封顶 |\n| 失败恢复 | 流失败/重复尝试及已发远端请求可能消费 | 核真实文件/进程、冲突和未验证结果，先查再重试 | rewind范围有限、取消非外部效果回滚，恢复工时未测 |\n| 升级与退出 | 新版本迁移、备份及日志/数据留存成本未知 | 关闭自动委派、停任务/进程、撤临时凭据、保产物与记录 | 全迁移/删除及跨版本兼容未核；卸载不撤业务副作用 |\n\n#### 效果与采用证据\n\n| 效果项 | 固定源码支持 | 未证明的效果 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 自主编码动作 | 普通模型Stream→执行→tool result→下一Stream | 代表任务正确率、少返工和替人工能力 |\n| 过程权限 | Gate/主体规则、ACP卡和明确拒绝结果 | 所有入口都由真人授权，尤其显式shell分流 |\n| 停止/预算 | context、轮数/三轴预算、缺项暂停 | 总费用精确封顶、全部外部进程/请求已停 |\n| 恢复 | 编辑文件预览、版本/并发重查和事务入口 | shell/网络副作用可逆或完整工作区原子恢复 |\n| DSH集成 | 配置包与本轮宿主prompt/权限源接线 | 当前pin可直接匹配所核宿主、默认reject足以安全自动委派 |\n\n达到人工阈值、实际输出错误、审批/计费身份不明、出现来源未明确的显式shell、越界路径、停止后未知进程/请求或恢复冲突时停止扩大权限和重复执行。保留diff、停因及用量，人工检查产物并从独立副本回退，撤临时凭据后再退出。若人工直用的复核/配置负担不低于现编码Agent或手工，保持原办法；不为展示“成功委派”把reject改allow或放弃外部隔离。",

      "content": "---\nowner: @SivanCola\nbackup: @esengine\nstatus: active\nreviewed: 2026-10-17\n---\n\n# Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness\n\n<a href=\"./ACP.md\">ACP</a>\n · \n<a href=\"https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/main/packages/subagent/subagent-acp\">DSH subagent-acp</a>\n · \n<a href=\"https://reasonix.io\">Reasonix website</a>\n\n## Purpose\n\nDeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can delegate a task to any Agent Client Protocol agent through its `subagent-acp` provider. Reasonix speaks ACP with `reasonix acp`, so a Harness agent can hand work to Reasonix as a subagent with no code on either side, only configuration.\n\nVerified against `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2 and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` 0.2.1-rc.2, with a real DeepSeek model in the Reasonix child.\n\n## Preconditions\n\n1. Reasonix MUST be installed on the machine that runs `dsh`, and its model provider MUST be set up there: run `reasonix setup` once.\n2. `reasonix` MUST be reachable by the command you configure (an absolute path is the safest).\n3. The provider key MUST live in Reasonix's own home (`<Reasonix home>/.env`, see [CONFIG_PATHS](./CONFIG_PATHS.md)). Reasonix does not read provider keys from environment variables, so the `env` block of the Harness row cannot supply one.\n4. The provider package version MUST equal the `dsh` version (`dsh --version`). Name it exactly: the `latest` tag points at an old `0.0.1-rc.1` and `next` may resolve to an older pre-release, and `dsh` refuses both as incompatible.\n\n## Steps\n\n1. Install the provider into the Harness profile you use:\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile <profile> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@<dsh version>\n```\n\n2. Add two rows to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`):\n\n```yaml\n- insert:\n    - id: subagent-acp\n      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp'\n      config:\n        providerName: reasonix\n        command: reasonix\n        args: ['acp']\n        permission: reject\n    - id: tool-subagent-reasonix\n      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'\n      config:\n        provider: reasonix\n        toolName: reasonix\n        maxDepth: provider-managed\n```\n\n3. Start `dsh`. The model now has a `reasonix` tool that takes a `prompt`, a short `description` and an optional `cwd`.\n\n`maxDepth: provider-managed` is required: the provider cannot enforce a depth cap in the child, and `dsh` refuses to load the tool row without it.\n\n## Ready-made package\n\nThe same two rows ship as a Harness bundle in this repository, `integrations/dsh-plugin`, so steps 1 and 2 can be one command. It is not on npm; `pnpm` installs the subdirectory through its `path:` selector (see [pnpm package sources](https://pnpm.io/package-sources)):\n\n```sh\ndsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix#path:/integrations/dsh-plugin\n```\n\nThe bundle pins `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` and `dsh` to the same version (`0.2.1-rc.2` today) and uses `permission: reject`. Change the policy in your own `cordis.patch.yml`, never in the package.\n\n## After installing: switch it on\n\nAn installed plugin starts **off**. Open its page in the DSH Web UI and turn its switch on.\n\n- The switch and both components (the provider and the `reasonix` tool) must read Running.\n- Turning the switch on in a running `dsh web` is enough: the next new session has the `reasonix` tool (observed on `dsh` 0.2.1-rc.2, 2026-10-18). Restart `dsh` only if it is still missing.\n- While it is off the model has no `reasonix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell instead.\n- That looks like a delegation and is not one: there is no subagent, no `reasonix` tool call, and no permission policy applies.\n\n## Finding it in Discover\n\nDSH ships an optional \"Custom plugin markets\" feature with no default index; a user adds index URLs themselves. This repository publishes one:\n\n1. In the DSH Web UI open Plugins, select More beside Experimental plugins and switch on Custom plugin markets.\n2. In the Discover tab add this index URL:\n\n```text\nhttps://raw.githubusercontent.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json\n```\n\n3. Select \"Reasonix subagent\" and install. The entry page shows the author, the website, the source repository and the exact pinned commit.\n\nThe index entry pins a commit, so it is re-pinned whenever the package changes (see the Studio release runbook).\n\n## Configuration reference\n\n| Key | Where | Meaning |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `command`, `args` | `subagent-acp` | What `dsh` spawns for every run. `['acp', '--model', '<name>']` selects the child model; `['acp', '--preset', 'delivery']` selects the execution setting. |\n| `cwd` | `subagent-acp` | Child workspace. Omitted: the delegating session's working directory. |\n| `permission` | `subagent-acp` | `reject` (default) or `allow`. See the next section. |\n| `env` | `subagent-acp` | Extra child environment, layered over a credential-scrubbed copy of the parent's. Use it for `REASONIX_HOME` when the child should use a different home. |\n| `maxDepth` | `tool-subagent` | MUST be `provider-managed`. |\n\n## Permission policy\n\n`dsh` never shows the child's permission cards to a person. The `permission` key answers every `session/request_permission` automatically:\n\n| Policy | Effect on Reasonix |\n| --- | --- |\n| `reject` | `dsh` answers `cancelled`. Reasonix treats it as a refusal: the tool call fails with \"blocked by permission policy\", the model is told the call was declined, and the turn goes on. Writes and shell commands that need approval do not run. |\n| `allow` | `dsh` selects the first `allow_once` or `allow_always` option of every request. Every approval card Reasonix raises is accepted without a person looking at it. |\n\nChoosing `allow` MUST be a deliberate decision to let the Harness agent, and whoever steers it, run whatever Reasonix's tools can do in that workspace.       "content": "package agent\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/event\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/provider\"\n)\n\n// landCause is why a turn was told to finalize. kind selects the pause the Run\n// ends with, so a host can tell \"spent its budget\" from \"hit the round assert\".\ntype landCause struct {\n\tkind   string\n\taxis   string\n\tdetail string\n}\n\nfunc (c landCause) nudge(state *turnRuntime) string {\n\tconst close = \"Do not call any more tools.       "content": "package agent\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/provider\"\n)\n\n// maxStepsPause is a resumable stop after a positive model-round budget.\ntype maxStepsPause struct {\n\tsteps     int\n\tkey       string\n\thostOwned bool\n}\n\nfunc (e *maxStepsPause) Error() string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"paused after %d tool-call rounds (%s) — the work so far is saved; send another message to continue, or set %s higher or to 0 for no limit\", e.steps, e.key, e.key)\n}\n\nfunc IsToolLoopPause(err error) bool {\n\tvar maxPause *maxStepsPause\n\tvar budgetPause *taskBudgetPause\n\treturn errors.As(err, &maxPause) || errors.As(err, &budgetPause)\n}\n\n// HostProgressSignatures exposes successful evidence identities to the Goal FSM.\nfunc (a *Agent) HostProgressSignatures() []string {\n\tif a == nil || a.task.ledger == nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\treturn a.task.ledger.SuccessfulProgressSignaturesSince(0)\n}\n\nfunc (a *Agent) stopUnexecutedBoundaryCalls(ctx context.Context, state *turnRuntime, calls []provider.ToolCall, usage *provider.Usage) (error, bool) {\n\tswitch {\n\tcase state.graceRound:\n\t\ta.pairUnexecutedGraceCalls(calls, \"blocked: the tool-call round budget is exhausted; no more tools will run in this turn\")\n\t\treturn a.gracePause(ctx, state), true\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn nil, false\n\t}\n}\n\n// resetTurnEvidence clears the ledger and the task budget together: a fresh\n// ledger is what \"a new task\" means here, and a continuation keeps both.\nfunc (a *Agent) resetTurnEvidence() {\n\ta.task.restartLedger()\n}\n"

      "path": "internal/runtime/agent/run_budget.go",
      "content": "package agent\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/event\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/pricing\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/provider\"\n)\n\n// TaskBudget bounds one task on the axes its failures are reported in, and\n// every axis ships off: stopping a task is the user's call. Tokens is the one\n// that generalizes — a slow expensive loop accumulates them and so does a fast\n// empty one, where wall clock catches only the first and money is not portable\n// across models.\ntype TaskBudget struct {\n\tCost   float64\n\tWall   time.Duration\n\tTokens int\n}\n\n// normalizeTaskBudget reads a negative value as unset, so a disabled axis and\n// an unconfigured one behave identically.\nfunc normalizeTaskBudget(b TaskBudget) TaskBudget {\n\tif b.Cost < 0 {\n\t\tb.Cost = 0\n\t}\n\tif b.Wall < 0 {\n\t\tb.Wall = 0\n\t}\n\tif b.Tokens < 0 {\n\t\tb.Tokens = 0\n\t}\n\treturn b\n}\n\n// runBudget accumulates what a turn has actually spent. Rounds are a poor proxy\n// for it: the same hundred of them cost minutes or hours depending on what each\n// one read and how long the model thought, and the failures worth stopping are\n// reported in hours and tokens, never in rounds.\ntype runBudget struct {\n\tstarted      time.Time\n\trounds       int\n\trequests     int\n\tpromptTokens int\n\toutputTokens int\n\ttokens       uint64\n\tcost         runCost\n\t// limit is configuration, not accumulation: it survives the reset that\n\t// starts a new task.\n\tlimit      TaskBudget\n\trootTokens *rootTokenBudget\n\trootOrigin rootBudgetOrigin\n}\n\n// observe folds one round's provider usage into the turn's running total.\n// A round whose usage never arrived still counts as a round, so the axis never\n// reads cheaper than the turn actually was.\nfunc (b *runBudget) observe(usage *provider.Usage, quote *pricing.CostQuote) {\n\tb.rounds++\n\tb.tokens = addBudgetTokens(b.tokens, budgetUsageTokens(usage))\n\tb.cost.observe(usage, quote)\n\tif usage == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tb.requests += usageRequestCount(usage)\n\tb.promptTokens += usage.PromptTokens\n\tb.outputTokens += usage.CompletionTokens\n}\n\nfunc (b *runBudget) elapsed() time.Duration {\n\tif b.started.IsZero() {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn time.Since(b.started)\n}\n\n// totals is the shadow reading for one scope: counts and money, never content.\nfunc (b *runBudget) totals() event.RunBudgetTotals {\n\treturn event.RunBudgetTotals{\n\t\tRounds:       b.rounds,\n\t\tRequests:     b.requests,\n\t\tPromptTokens: b.promptTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens: b.outputTokens,\n\t\tCost:         b.cost.amount().Float64(),\n\t\tPriced:       b.cost.complete(),\n\t\tElapsedMs:    b.elapsed().Milliseconds(),\n\t}\n}\n\n// exceeded names the first axis the task has spent past, or \"\" while inside\n// the budget. Known priced spend is a lower bound even when other rounds lack\n// usage or prices; unknown spend cannot erase a proven crossing.\nfunc (b *runBudget) exceeded(limit TaskBudget) (axis, detail string) {\n\tif limit.Tokens > 0 {\n\t\tif used := b.tokens; used >= uint64(limit.Tokens) {\n\t\t\treturn \"token\", fmt.Sprintf(\"task used %d tokens, reaching the %d budget\", used, limit.Tokens)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif limit.Cost > 0 && b.cost.pricedRounds > 0 && b.cost.amount() >= max(pricing.Amount(1), pricing.NewAmountFromFloat(limit.Cost)) {\n\t\treturn \"cost\", fmt.Sprintf(\"task spend %.4f reached the %.4f budget\", b.cost.amount().Float64(), limit.Cost)\n\t}\n\tif limit.Wall > 0 {\n\t\tif elapsed := b.elapsed(); elapsed >= limit.Wall {\n\t\t\treturn \"time\", fmt.Sprintf(\"task ran %s, past the %s budget\",\n\t\t\t\telapsed.Round(time.Second), limit.Wall)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\", \"\"\n}\n\n// taskBudgetLimit resolves this turn's bound: a host-injected budget wins over\n// the configured one, which is how an unattended loop gets a ceiling while\n// ordinary chat keeps none.\nfunc (a *Agent) taskBudgetLimit(ctx context.Context) TaskBudget {\n\tif b, ok := taskBudgetFromContext(ctx); ok {\n\t\treturn b\n\t}\n\treturn a.task.budget.limit\n}\n\n// ResetTaskBudget starts a fresh user-approved spend slice without touching\n// Delivery evidence or the persisted Goal usage totals. Callers use this only\n// after a resumable explicit-budget pause, while no Agent Run is active.\nfunc (a *Agent) ResetTaskBudget() {\n\ta.task.budget = runBudget{limit: a.task.budget.limit}\n}\n\n// observeRunBudget folds a round into both scopes and reports them.\nfunc (a *Agent) observeRunBudget(state *turnRuntime, usage *provider.Usage, quote *pricing.CostQuote) {\n\tif state == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tstate.budget.rootTokens.observe(usage)\n\tstate.budget.observe(usage, quote)\n\tif a.task.budget.started.IsZero() {\n\t\ta.task.budget.started = state.budget.started\n\t}\n\ta.task.budget.observe(usage, quote)\n\tcurrency := \"\"\n\tif a.svc.pricing != nil {\n\t\tcurrency = a.svc.pricing.Symbol()\n\t}\n\tif state.budget.cost.currency != \"\" {\n\t\tcurrency = pricing.CurrencySymbol(state.budget.cost.currency)\n\t}\n\tevent.RecordRunBudget(a.svc.sink, event.RunBudgetSample{\n\t\tTurn:     state.budget.totals(),\n\t\tTask:     a.task.budget.totals(),\n\t\tCurrency: currency,\n\t})\n}\n\ntype taskBudgetContextKey struct{}\n\n// WithTaskBudget overrides a run's task budget for one turn. The agent serving\n// an unattended loop and the one serving chat are the same instance, so the\n// bound is a property of the turn, not of construction.\nfunc WithTaskBudget(ctx context.Context, b TaskBudget) context.Context {\n\treturn context.WithValue(ctx, taskBudgetContextKey{}, normalizeTaskBudget(b))\n}\n\nfunc taskBudgetFromContext(ctx context.Context) (TaskBudget, bool) {\n\tif ctx == nil {\n\t\treturn TaskBudget{}, false\n\t}\n\tb, ok := ctx.Value(taskBudgetContextKey{}).(TaskBudget)\n\treturn b, ok\n}\n"

      "path": "internal/runtime/agent/run_cost.go",
      "content": "package agent\n\nimport (\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/pricing\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/provider\"\n)\n\ntype runCost struct {\n\tamounts      map[string]pricing.Amount\n\tcurrency     string\n\tpricedRounds int\n\tincomplete   bool\n}\n\nfunc (c *runCost) observe(usage *provider.Usage, quote *pricing.CostQuote) {\n\tif quote != nil && quote.Original.Currency != \"\" {\n\t\tc.currency = pricing.NormalizeCurrency(quote.Original.Currency)\n\t}\n\tif usage == nil || usage.Estimated || quote == nil || pricing.NormalizeCurrency(quote.Original.Currency) == \"\" || len(quote.OriginalTotals) > 0 {\n\t\tc.incomplete = true\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tamount, err := pricing.NewAmountFromString(quote.Original.Amount)\n\tif err != nil || amount < 0 {\n\t\tc.incomplete = true\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tq := pricing.NormalizeQuote(*quote)\n\t// An explicitly reported zero retains its known zero subtotal even though\n\t// the quote layer classifies a no-token record as incomplete usage.\n\tzero := usage.PromptTokens == 0 && usage.CompletionTokens == 0 && usage.TotalTokens == 0 &&\n\t\tusage.CacheHitTokens == 0 && usage.CacheMissTokens == 0 && usage.CacheWriteTokens == 0 && usage.CacheWriteBilledTokens == 0\n\tif !q.CostComplete && !(zero && q.IncompleteReason == \"missing_price_or_usage\" && amount == 0) {\n\t\tc.incomplete = true\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif c.amounts == nil {\n\t\tc.amounts = map[string]pricing.Amount{}\n\t}\n\tc.amounts[c.currency] = c.amounts[c.currency].Add(amount)\n\tc.pricedRounds++\n}\n\nfunc (c *runCost) amount() pricing.Amount { return c.amounts[c.currency] }\n\nfunc (c *runCost) complete() bool {\n\treturn !c.incomplete && c.pricedRounds > 0 && len(c.amounts) == 1\n}\n"

      "path": "internal/runtime/agent/run_loop.go",
      "content": "package agent\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand/v2\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/hostaudit\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/state/sessionstore\"\n\t\"slices\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"sync/atomic\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/agentpreset\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/event\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/planmode\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/provider\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/tool\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/runtime/taskpolicy\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/safety/evidence\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/tools/jobs\"\n)\n\n// streamedTurn is one provider completion collected by stream. Keeping the\n// result together makes the missing-reasoning recovery path explicit: the\n// first, malformed completion is never committed before a safe replacement is\n// available, and a failed recovery can still fall back to the complete first\n// response without re-running any tool.\ntype streamedTurn struct {\n\ttext               string\n\treasoning          string\n\tthoughtMs          int64 // see thoughtClock\n\tfirstTokenMs       int64 // see thoughtClock; 0 = not measured\n\tsignature          string\n\treasoningID        string\n\treasoningStatus    string\n\tcalls              []provider.ToolCall\n\tresponsesItems     []json.RawMessage\n\tusage              *provider.Usage\n\tinterrupted        bool\n\tpartialToolStarted bool\n\tpartialCalls       []provider.ToolCall\n\tmaxArgChars        int      // peak streaming tool-arg size for failed-attempt estimates\n\tattemptID          string   // the stream attempt this result came from, for usage correlation\n\tbodyChain          []string // cumulative hashes of the messages this request actually sent\n\t// perseverationAborted marks a stream the opt-in cut path ended early. It is\n\t// a clean terminal (err == nil): the caller nudges and retries, then stops\n\t// with a perseveration pause once the retry budget is spent.\n\tperseverationAborted bool\n\t// perseverationDetected marks a stream where the guard saw a degenerate loop\n\t// but did not cut it. The round reports it through the progress-watch\n\t// channel; the stream itself runs to its own terminal.\n\tperseverationDetected bool\n\terr                   error\n}\n\n// deferredStreamSink keeps selected stream events local until the caller\n// chooses which provider response to adopt. On an ordinary healthy DeepSeek\n// turn, reasoning arrives before tool calls and unlocks live tool-card events.\n// On the rare malformed turn with no reasoning, only the speculative partial\n// tool cards remain buffered, so retrying does not flash duplicate cards in the\n// UI. A recovery attempt buffers everything because it may be discarded.\ntype deferredStreamSink struct {\n\tinner               event.Sink\n\tdeferAll            bool\n\twaitingForReasoning bool\n\tsawReasoning        bool\n\tevents              []event.Event\n}\n\nfunc newReasoningAwareStreamSink(inner event.Sink) *deferredStreamSink {\n\treturn &deferredStreamSink{inner: inner, waitingForReasoning: true}\n}\n\nfunc newDeferredStreamSink(inner event.Sink) *deferredStreamSink {\n\treturn &deferredStreamSink{inner: inner, deferAll: true}\n}\n\nfunc (s *deferredStreamSink) Emit(e event.Event) {\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif s.deferAll {\n\t\ts.events = append(s.events, e)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif s.waitingForReasoning && e.Kind == event.Reasoning && strings.TrimSpace(e.Text) != \"\" {\n\t\ts.sawReasoning = true\n\t\ts.inner.Emit(e)\n\t\ts.flushBuffered()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif s.waitingForReasoning && !s.sawReasoning && e.Kind == event.ToolDispatch {\n\t\ts.events = append(s.events, e)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\ts.inner.Emit(e)\n}\n\nfunc (s *deferredStreamSink) flushBuffered() {\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, e := range s.events {\n\t\ts.inner.Emit(e)\n\t}\n\ts.events = nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *deferredStreamSink) Flush() {\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\ts.flushBuffered()\n}\n\nfunc (s *deferredStreamSink) Discard() {\n\tif s != nil {\n\t\ts.events = nil\n\t}\n}\n\n// beginRunTurn handles evidence scope, delivery classification, background-job\n// evidence re-lease, and the initial user-turn persistence. Path is what the\n// probe found rather than a name to look up later, so a host carrying two of\n// them offers two rows instead of one ambiguous \"bash\".\ntype ShellOption struct {\n\tName           string `json:\"name\"`\n\tPath           string `json:\"path\"`\n\tVersion        string `json:\"version,omitempty\"`\n\tSupportsAndAnd bool   `json:\"supportsAndAnd\"`\n\t// Prefer is the value SaveShellSettings takes to select this option.\n\tPrefer string `json:\"prefer\"`\n}\n\n// ShellSettings is the shell tool's interpreter as an editor needs it: what is\n// configured, what that resolved to, and what else is installed. Options are\n// probed instead of listed from a fixed table — offering a shell the host does\n// not have is a switch that breaks every command it accepts.\ntype ShellSettings struct {\n\tPrefer string `json:\"prefer\"`\n\tPath   string `json:\"path,omitempty\"`\n\t// Args are the saved launcher arguments for Path, and Argv the exact command\n\t// line that was run to verify them when they are in force.\n\tArgs      []string    `json:\"args,omitempty\"`\n\tArgv      []string    `json:\"argv,omitempty\"`\n\tEffective ShellOption `json:\"effective\"`\n\t// Auto is what detection picks here, so \"自动\" can name its own outcome.\n\tAuto     ShellOption   `json:\"auto\"`\n\tOptions  []ShellOption `json:\"options\"`\n\tPlatform string        `json:\"platform\"`\n}\n\n// ShellSettings reads the configured interpreter and everything installed\n// beside it.\nfunc (c *Controller) ShellSettings() ShellSettings {\n\tprefer, path := \"auto\", \"\"\n\tvar args []string\n\tvar confine func(string) bool\n\tif cfg, err := config.Load(); err == nil {\n\t\tif p := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Tools.Shell.Prefer); p != \"\" {\n\t\t\tprefer = strings.ToLower(p)\n\t\t}\n\t\tpath = strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Tools.Shell.Path)\n\t\targs = cfg.Tools.Shell.Args\n\t\tconfine = sandbox.BashConfine(cfg.BashMode(), cfg.Roots().SandboxDir())\n\t}\n\tauto := sandbox.ShellDiscovery{Confine: confine}.Resolve()\n\teffective := auto\n\tif prefer != \"auto\" || path != \"\" {\n\t\teffective = sandbox.ShellDiscovery{Prefer: prefer, Path: path, Args: args, Confine: confine}.Resolve()\n\t}\n\tout := ShellSettings{\n\t\tPrefer:    prefer,\n\t\tPath:      path,\n\t\tArgs:      args,\n\t\tEffective: shellOption(effective),\n\t\tAuto:      shellOption(auto),\n\t\tPlatform:  shellrun.DescriptorFromShell(auto).Platform,\n\t}\n\tif got := effective.Args(); len(got) > 0 {\n\t\tout.Argv = append([]string{effective.Path}, got...)\n\t}\n\tfor _, sh := range sandbox.DetectShells() {\n\t\tout.Options = append(out.Options, shellOption(sh))\n\t}\n\tout.Options = oneGitBashPerInstall(out.Options, out.Effective.Path)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// oneGitBashPerInstall keeps a single row per Git for Windows install. Its\n// bin/bash.exe is a launcher for usr/bin/bash.exe, so offering both draws two\n// \"Git Bash\" buttons that run the same program. The row matching keep wins, so\n// a pinned path still shows as selected.\nfunc oneGitBashPerInstall(opts []ShellOption, keep string) []ShellOption {\n\tat := map[string]int{}\n\tout := opts[:0:0]\n\tfor _, o := range opts {\n\t\tif o.Name != tool.ShellNameGitBash {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, o)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\troot := gitInstallRoot(o.Path)\n\t\ti, seen := at[root]\n\t\tif !seen {\n\t\t\tat[root] = len(out)\n\t\t\tout = append(out, o)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif strings.EqualFold(o.Path, keep) {\n\t\t\tout[i] = o\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc gitInstallRoot(path string) string {\n\tp := strings.ToLower(strings.ReplaceAll(path, \"\\\\\", \"/\"))\n\tfor _, tail := range []string{\"/usr/bin/bash.exe\", \"/bin/bash.exe\", \"/usr/bin/bash\", \"/bin/bash\"} {\n\t\tif root, ok := strings.CutSuffix(p, tail); ok {\n\t\t\treturn root\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn p\n}\n\n// SaveShellSettings persists the interpreter choice after proving it runs: a\n// path that cannot execute is refused on the screen that typed it rather than\n// on every command afterwards. The caller rebuilds the runtime, because boot\n// binds the interpreter into the shell tool while assembling it.\nfunc (c *Controller) SaveShellSettings(prefer, path string, args ...string) error {\n\tif len(args) > 0 {\n\t\tif _, err := sandbox.VerifyLauncher(prefer, path, args); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"这个 shell 用不了：%w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t} else if err := sandbox.VerifyShell(prefer, path); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"这个 shell 用不了：%w\", err)\n\t}\n\tunlock := config.LockUserConfigEdits()\n\tdefer unlock()\n\tcfg := config.LoadForEdit(config.UserConfigPath())\n\tif err := cfg.SetShell(prefer, path, args...); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn cfg.SaveTo(config.UserConfigPath())\n}\n\nfunc shellOption(sh sandbox.Shell) ShellOption {\n\tex := shellrun.DescriptorFromShell(sh)\n\topt := ShellOption{\n\t\tName:           ex.Shell,\n\t\tPath:           sh.Path,\n\t\tVersion:        ex.ShellVersion,\n\t\tSupportsAndAnd: ex.SupportsAndAnd,\n\t\tPrefer:         \"bash\",\n\t}\n\tswitch ex.Shell {\n\tcase tool.ShellNamePwsh:\n\t\topt.Prefer = \"pwsh\"\n\tcase tool.ShellNamePowerShell:\n\t\topt.Prefer = \"powershell\"\n\t}\n\treturn opt\n}\n\n// shellContextBytes bounds how much of a user command's output goes into the\n// conversation; the rest is cut from the middle and the cut is said.\nconst shellContextBytes = 24 << 10\n\n// ShellRun is how a command the user typed is followed up.\ntype ShellRun struct {\n\t// LocalOnly keeps the command the user's own: its output is shown, and\n\t// neither it nor a reply to it enters the conversation.\n\tLocalOnly bool\n}\n\n// answerShell puts a command the user ran into the conversation and lets the\n// model respond to it, the way a line typed to the agent would be. A command\n// the user stopped is not followed by a turn, and neither is one run with no\n// model to answer it.\nfunc (c *Controller) answerShell(ctx context.Context, command, state string, exit *int, output, errText string) error {\n\tif c.runner == nil || state == tool.ShellStateCancelled {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tinput := shellTurnInput(command, exit, output, errText)\n\treturn c.runTurnLoop(ctx, orchestratedTurn{input: input, raw: input, display: \"!\" + command})\n}\n\nfunc shellTurnInput(command string, exit *int, output, errText string) string {\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\tb.WriteString(\"I ran this command in my terminal:\\n<bash-input>\" + command + \"</bash-input>\\n\")\n\tif exit != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(&b, \"<bash-exit-code>%d</bash-exit-code>\\n\", *exit)\n\t}\n\tif errText != \"\" {\n\t\tb.WriteString(\"<bash-error>\" + errText + \"</bash-error>\\n\")\n\t}\n\tif len(output) > shellContextBytes {\n\t\thalf := shellContextBytes / 2\n\t\thead, tail := strings.ToValidUTF8(output[:half], \"\"), strings.ToValidUTF8(output[len(output)-half:], \"\")\n\t\toutput = fmt.Sprintf(\"%s\\n[… %d bytes of output cut from the middle …]\\n%s\", head, len(output)-2*half, tail)\n\t}\n\tb.WriteString(\"<bash-output>\\n\" + output + \"\\n</bash-output>\")\n\treturn b.String()\n}\n\n// shellTimeout is the maximum time a user-invoked \"!command\" may run. Matches\n// the bash tool's timeout so behaviour is consistent across invocation paths.\nconst shellTimeout = 120 * time.Second\n\n// shellWaitDelay bounds how long cmd.Run() waits after context cancellation for\n// the child's pipes to drain, matching the bash tool's WaitDelay.\nconst shellWaitDelay = 5 * time.Second\n\nfunc shellCommandPreview(command string) string {\n\tcommand = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(command, \"\\n\", \" \"))\n\tconst max = 48\n\tr := []rune(command)\n\tif len(r) > max {\n\t\treturn string(r[:max]) + \"…\"\n\t}\n\treturn command\n}\n\n// RunShell executes a shell command directly (bypassing the model) and streams\n// the output as ToolDispatch/ToolProgress/ToolResult events. It uses the same\n// bash-tool infrastructure (shell resolution, timeout) and shares the runGuarded\n// lock with model turns — only one can run at a time. User-invoked \"!\" commands\n// run without the OS sandbox (the user typed the command explicitly).\nfunc (c *Controller) RunShell(command string) {\n\tc.RunShellWith(command, ShellRun{})\n}\n\n// RunShellWith is RunShell with how the command is followed up spelled out.\nfunc (c *Controller) RunShellWith(command string, opts ShellRun) {\n\tif binding := c.CompositionBinding(); binding != nil && nil)\n\t\t}\n\t\targv, _ := sandbox.Command(sandbox.Spec{}, sh, command) // false = unsandboxed (user invoked)\n\n\t\tpreview := []rune(command)\n\t\tif len(preview) > 32 {\n\t\t\tpreview = preview[:32]\n\t\t}\n\t\tid := \"shell-\" + string(preview)\n\t\tdiagnosticPreview := shellCommandPreview(command)\n\t\tdesc := shellrun.DescriptorFromShell(sh)\n\n\t\tc.sink.Emit(event.Event{\n\t\t\tKind: event.ToolDispatch,\n\t\t\tTool: event.Tool{\n\t\t\t\tID:     id,\n\t\t\t\tName:   \"bash\",\n\t\t\t\tArgs:   fmt.Sprintf(`{\"command\":%q}`, command),\n\t\t\t\tIssuer: event.IssuedByUser,\n\t\t\t\tExecution: &event.ShellExecution{\n\t\t\t\t\tKind: desc.Kind, Shell: desc.Shell, ShellVersion: desc.ShellVersion,\n\t\t\t\t\tPlatform: desc.Platform, SupportsAndAnd: desc.SupportsAndAnd,\n\t\t\t\t\tState: tool.ShellStateRunning,\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t})\n\n\t\tstart := time.Now()\n\t\tres := shellrun.RunForeground(ctx, shellrun.Request{\n\t\t\tArgv:           argv,\n\t\t\tDir:            c.workspaceRoot,\n\t\t\tEnv:            shellrun.CommandEnv(ctx),\n\t\t\tTimeout:        shellTimeout,\n\t\t\tWaitDelay:      shellWaitDelay,\n\t\t\tCommandPreview: diagnosticPreview,\n\t\t\tShellKind:      sh.Kind.String(),\n\t\t\tShellPath:      sh.Path,\n\t\t\tSource:         \"user_shell\",\n\t\t\tTrack:          true,\n\t\t\tProgress: func(chunk string) {\n\t\t\t\tc.sink.Emit(event.Event{\n\t\t\t\t\tKind: event.ToolProgress,\n\t\t\t\t\tTool: event.Tool{ID: id, Output: chunk},\n\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t})\n\t\tdurationMs := time.Since(start).Milliseconds()\n\t\tex := &event.ShellExecution{\n\t\t\tKind: desc.Kind, Shell: desc.Shell, ShellVersion: desc.ShellVersion,\n\t\t\tPlatform: desc.Platform, SupportsAndAnd: desc.SupportsAndAnd,\n\t\t\tState: res.State, FailurePhase: res.FailurePhase,\n\t\t\tOutputTail: res.OutputTail, DurationMs: fmt.Sprintf(i18n.M.ShellExecFailedFmt, res.Err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.sink.Emit(event.Event{\n\t\t\tKind: event.ToolResult,\n\t\t\tTool: event.Tool{\n\t\t\t\tID: id, Name: \"bash\", Output:       "content": "package control\n\n// Where a turn begins: the verbs a frontend calls to send input, and the loop\n// carrying one turn through the runner. What a running turn does lives in the\n// turn_* files beside this one.\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/state/sessionstore\"\n\t\"slices\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/event\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/provider\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/contract/tool\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/ext/extension\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/ext/skill\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/runtime/agent\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/runtime/langpref\"\n\t\"reasonix/internal/tools/jobs\"\n)\n\nfunc turnOutcome(err error) string {\n\tvar readinessErr *agent.FinalReadinessError\n\tif errors.As(err, &readinessErr) {\n\t\treturn event.TurnOutcomeFinalReadiness\n\t}\n\tif info, ok := agent.InspectRunPause(err); ok &&\n\t\t(info.Kind == agent.PauseKindNoProgress || info.Kind == agent.PauseKindPerseveration) {\n\t\treturn event.TurnOutcomeNoProgress\n\t}\n\treturn \"\"\n}\n\n// Send starts a turn with an uncomposed message. The controller applies\n// plan-mode, memory, and background-job framing inside the async turn path.\nfunc (c *Controller) Send(input string) {\n\tc.SendWithRaw(input, input)\n}\n\n// SendWithRaw starts a turn with separate model input and raw prompt text.\nfunc (c *Controller) SendWithRaw(input, raw string) {\n\tc.runGuarded(func(ctx context.Context) error {\n\t\treturn c.runTurnLoop(ctx, orchestratedTurn{input: input, raw: raw})\n\t})\n}\n\n// runTurnLoop runs one model turn under the plan-approval gate, then keeps\n// pursuing an active Goal with it — with no goal the loop is what a single turn\n// looks like, plus whatever that turn still owes.
